_comment: Skills this workflow uses, by group. Bodies are not vendored: each entry points at its upstream source. `use` says who calls it: a role (architect, builder, escalation, review, docs) through skills-manifest.json, or `human` for skills you invoke yourself (`invocation: user` means the model cannot load it). Install targets Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode together.

obsolete.grill-me: duplicate of grilling for this workflow

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Interview loop: facts from the code, decisions from the user one at a time.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Pin domain vocabulary in GLOSSARY.md and record decisions as ADRs.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Deep-module vocabulary: seams, interface depth, information hiding.

skills.name: prototype
skills.description: Throwaway prototype to answer a behaviour or UI question by seeing it.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Primary-source research written to a Markdown file in the repo.

skills.name: why
skills.description: Recover the rationale behind existing code from history, issues and docs.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Chart work too large for one session as a map of investigation tickets.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Find deepening opportunities and grill through the one you pick.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Red-green-refactor at the seams the spec agreed.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, fix: used before a Builder escalates.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Standards and Spec axes reviewed independently.

skills.name: pr
skills.description: PR body: summary visual, before/after evidence, merge-danger call.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: After a session: improve the agent's environment, not the code.

skills.name: blast-radius
skills.description: Find what a change breaks beyond the diff and prove the safety fact by running code.

skills.name: create-verification-skill
skills.description: Generate a project-local skill that drives the real app end to end.
